smoke.verdict: PASS (offline ritual: verdict CLEAN, exit 0) + live pipeline NOT_RUN
smoke.notes: Live run needs DEEPSEEK/TYPESAFE/DEEPINFRA keys and network — forbidden by dog-food rules, so NOT_RUN with that reason. The offline credential scanner is green: 2 hits, both RECEIPTED-BENIGN (the dead, rolled deepseek credential in a sealed receipt, never-delete-data law). Offline structural check also re-validated artifacts: runs/2026-10-01-run1/graph.json parses with 49 nodes / 104 edges, exactly as README claims; judges/verdict.json carries typesafe p_complete 0.71 / p_faulty 0.27.

essence: Cheap models decompose a big model's CoT into a receipted cellular graph.

ideas.name: A big idea becomes a cellular graph via cheap models
ideas.statement: A large model's chain-of-thought (3 lens-persona samples, because the endpoint ignores seed) is split into typed steps, wired with load-bearing scores and dependency edges, merged across seeds (occurrence = weight, divergence = alternate routes), then judged with gaps folded back as critique cells.

ideas.name: Judgment is separated from composition
ideas.statement: No model judges nodes it composed: flash composes, typesafe batteries score, Hermes attacks adversarially; a reasoner that burns its budget on reasoning is retried at 3x, not allowed to pass silently.

ideas.name: Entropy and seeds are disciplined inputs
ideas.statement: Seeds come from true quantum per-bit jobs fail-closed to os.urandom with per-bit flags; recorded even though the endpoint ignores them — book-keeping is the point.

ideas.name: The pipeline is resumable, receipted, and self-guarding
ideas.statement: Per-phase state files with atomic tmp+fsync+rename writes, per-sample resume, one append-only ledger per run; the credential incident became a standing pre-push keyscan ritual with receipted-benign suppressions and a verbatim incident record.

parts.name: Lens-sampled chain-of-thought
parts.essence: 3x deepseek-v4-pro samples of the same prompt under skeptic/engineer/teacher lenses; CoT + answer + usage + finish_reason captured per sample; diversity is enforced by persona because the seed parameter is accepted but ignored (probe-receipted).
parts.gate: Burn-guard: finish=length with empty content triggers a 3x-budget retry
parts.failure_mode: A reasoner that spends the whole budget on reasoning would yield an empty sample

parts.name: Split: typed step compression
parts.essence: deepseek-flash compresses each CoT into <=8 typed steps (PREMISE | INFERENCE | CHECK | DECISION | CONCLUSION) with a JSON repair loop.
parts.gate: Steps must parse to the typed schema — malformed JSON goes through repair, not silently onward
parts.failure_mode: Untyped dumps would make wiring and merging undefined

parts.name: Wire: load-bearing battery
parts.essence: typesafe.ai (jev-latest) battery per sample: rubric 0-3 load-bearing score per step (expectation = sum p_i * i) plus a dependency choice per step — edges with probabilities.
parts.failure_mode: Unweighted edges would lose the strength signal that routing later needs

parts.name: Merge: cross-seed agreement as weight
parts.essence: flash aligns steps across samples into clusters; occurrence count = cross-seed weight; kept-out divergences become ALTERNATE ROUTES — the convergence/divergence structure of the big model's idea becomes visible per-cell.
parts.failure_mode: Averaging across seeds would erase exactly the divergence signal this stage exists to keep

parts.name: Judge and fold-back
parts.essence: The larger model judges the merged graph against the original prompt (thoroughness 0-10 + up to 5 gaps); flash folds the gaps back in as origin='critique' cells -> graph v2 — a quilt that grows its own missing cells.
outputs: judge score + gaps -> critique cells (graph v2)
parts.gate: The judge's gaps must become cells, not a footnote
parts.failure_mode: First run judged 6/10 and the five gaps became five critique cells — the finding is the payload

parts.name: Compose/test separation
parts.essence: run-1 discipline: flash composes, typesafe and Hermes-3-405B judge; no model judges a node set it composed; flash cross-reviews typesafe-only nodes; the separation is receipted in judges/verdict.json.
parts.gate: A judge must never see only its own compositions
parts.failure_mode: Self-judging would inflate completeness (p_complete 0.71 came from an independent battery)

parts.name: Budget and retry policy
parts.essence: run-1 budget <= ~20 provider calls (planned 10, reserves for JSON repair); burn-guard retries at 3x budget (12k -> 36k tokens); remediation path --redo-seed re-calls ONE contaminated seed and reuses every other cached stage verbatim.
parts.gate: Total calls capped; every retry and remediation receipted, all-in spend declared ($0.098)
parts.failure_mode: Unbounded retries would silently burn credits

parts.name: Quantum seed discipline
parts.essence: 3x16 true quantum bits from mothquantum coin-toss per-bit jobs, parallel, fail-closed to os.urandom with per-bit flags; flagship run 48/48 true bits; entropy_bits_true < 16 marks any fallback bit.
parts.gate: Every bit must be labeled true-quantum or fail-closed — no unlabeled mixing
parts.failure_mode: Silent urandom fallback would fake quantum provenance

parts.name: Atomic receipted runs, resumable
parts.essence: Every phase persists state/<phase>.json atomically (tmp + fsync + rename) and receipts each call into seeds/ledger.jsonl (append-only); interrupted runs resume per-sample; runs are keyed by content, not wall clock.
outputs: resumable run directories with sealed ledgers
parts.gate: Receipt writes must be atomic — a mid-write kill once truncated a receipt and the lesson is receipted
parts.failure_mode: Partial writes would poison resume; the 63-a-r audit-then-remediate path exercised this for real

parts.name: Cell signature (drop into a quilt)
parts.essence: The output contract: graph_v1 nodes -> value cells; edges -> links with p as dial weight; judge.gaps -> question-cells; critique nodes -> origin='critique' next-generation cells; typesafe load-scores -> cell resolution policy.
parts.failure_mode: Without a drop-in contract the graph stays a research artifact

parts.name: Keyscan ritual
parts.essence: Pre-push credential scanner over HEAD tree + staged diff + worktree for gsk_/sk-/ghp_/github_pat_/apikey_/moth_/cfut_ patterns with length guards; matched values are NEVER printed; exit 0 only when clean or every hit matches a receipted-benign suppression.
parts.gate: Exit 1 on any un-receipted credential-shaped hit — the scanner must never become the leak
parts.failure_mode: Verified live: verdict CLEAN with 2 receipted-benign hits, exit 0

parts.name: Incident ledger (never-delete-data)
parts.essence: The leaked deepseek credential stays verbatim in the sealed receipt; it is DEAD (rolled by principal); suppressions carry written justifications pointing at SECURITY-INCIDENT.md — suppression means receipted and inert, never ignore-the-future.
parts.gate: A suppression requires a written justification + pointer to the incident record
parts.failure_mode: Deleting the evidence would hide the class of bug instead of the credential

cells.expr: 48 true quantum bits, per-bit fail-closed flags
flash -> <=8 typed steps + JSON repair loop
typesafe battery: load scores + dependency choices -> weighted edges
v4-pro thoroughness 0-10 + gaps; separation receipt enforced
gaps folded back as origin='critique' nodes -> graph v2
atomic per-phase state files, content-keyed runs
<=20 provider calls; burn-guard retries at 3x budget
pre-push credential scan; exit 1 on un-receipted hit

layer_logic.0: Substrate: other models' reasoning traces plus true quantum seed bits — the raw material is itself generated content, so provenance labels ride on every sample.
layer_logic.1: Mechanisms are the five pipeline phases (CoT -> split -> wire -> merge -> judge+fold), each receipted, each transforming graphs of text into typed, weighted cell graphs.
layer_logic.2: Policy: compose/test separation, burn-guard retries, a hard provider-call budget, per-bit entropy honesty, and the rule that judge gaps must become cells.
layer_logic.3: Interfaces: atomic content-keyed run directories with append-only ledgers, per-sample resume, and the drop-in cell signature that turns a graph into quilt cells.
layer_logic.4: Evidence: per-call receipts with usage and latency, the separation receipt, and the keyscan ritual with its never-delete-data incident ledger — the repo polices its own leaks.
